versions.changelog: v0.2.1 bug-fix release. patch.py: RFC 6902 compliance fix. The 'remove' op now correctly returns exit 1 when the target path does not exist (previously silently returned 0). This matches the RFC and lets agents detect failed removals in CI pipelines. Also catches out-of-bounds array indices for /items/N where N >= len(items). No CLI changes. Regression tested: existing-key remove + array-index remove still work.

v0.2.0: Two big additions for AI agents working with JSON configs. scripts/merge.py - cascade multiple JSON files with 5 strategies: deep (default, recursive merge with array-replace), shallow (top-level only), array-concat (deep + arrays concatenated), array-uniq (deep + dedup arrays), array-extend (require all inputs be arrays, concatenate into one big list). The classic 'defaults + user + env-specific configs' merge. scripts/patch.py - full RFC 6902 JSON Patch implementation: add, remove, replace, move, copy, test ops. Inline single-op via --op/--path/--value or load from --patch FILE. --strict aborts at first failure; --dry-run prints to stdout instead of writing. Supports '/items/-' append-to-array syntax. Same safe-path policy and 0/1/2 exit-code contract.

v0.1.0 initial release. Fourth skill in the clean-* family (after csv, text, log). Four scripts in pure stdlib: inspect.py (path-tree profile with types and samples), query.py (jq-style path queries with .key, .key[N], .[] iterate, .key.[].field map; --json/--jsonl/--lines/--raw output modes; implicit top-level iteration on JSONL), flatten.py (nested<->flat with dot or bracket index style, roundtrip-safe), validate.py (small pragmatic schema: required/type/min/max/length/enum/regex/item_type/allow_extra). Auto-detects JSON vs JSONL. Safe-path policy and 0/1/2 exit-code contract. Zero third-party dependencies.
